Name: doubly_robust_iptw_estimation
Title: Doubly Robust Inverse Probability Treatment Weighting for Confounding Adjustment
Experiment: Combine a propensity score model with an outcome regression model to achieve double robustness against misspecification when estimating Average Treatment Effect (ATE) under observational biomass exposure.

Name: covariate_balancing_propensity_score
Title: Covariate Balancing Optimization to Minimize Absolute Standardized Mean Difference (ASMD)
Experiment: Directly optimize treatment weights by bounding the dual loss of ASMD across all observed demographic and clinical covariates, comparing covariate overlap against standard logistic propensity weighting.
